title: WIDGET/ Esthetic/ Change background color intensity
body:
If it is not too much work, it would be nice to be able to change the saturation of the background color. The big massive gray bloc looks "old" compared to other widgets (time in the below example)

![Screenshot_20220405-134454_One UI Home.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/161747663-01137455-eba0-48c5-a9a2-b0e1f23bbc94.jpg)

comments.body:
As a proposal I would try a black with alpha .
Than it will have a nice glass look

Black with alpha is black with x% transparency.
You can set any Color with an alpha value .
If you take black with an alpha value you get a glass effect .
If you take white with alpha it’s like a milk glass effect
